title: Dianna Russini bodycam footage puts New York Times in an awkward spot

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dianna Russini bodycam footage puts New York Times in an awkward spot
sources.description: Last week's lengthy article from the New York Times about former New York Times reporter Dianna Russini opened with her story about FaceTiming an NFL coach in an effort to get out of a ticket for texting while driving.
